l3_title: Feature Record And Typed Dependency Edges
goal: stable feature graph node with typed inputs and outputs
positive_oracle: nodes rail->profile->sweep; typed GeometryRef vs ScalarMm -> 3 nodes, edges follow typed IO; a curve fed into ScalarMm is rejected
negative_oracle: feed CurveRef into ScalarMm input; a port role or output kind that does not match -> Invalid('object bound to scalar input'), Invalid('typed input port role'), Invalid('typed feature output')
checkout: QymCAD/ (vendored subtree of the main repository; no independent .git)
method: bounded file reads with line numbers; decisions are OM9-owned and no upstream code is copied

observed_symbols: feature timeline model; references use stable ids only, never indices
planned_anchors.what_is_missing: no typed input/output port on a node: a feature is an ordered timeline entry, so a curve fed into a scalar parameter is refused by the command layer, not recorded on the node

observed_symbols: FaceKey { index, centroid, normal, id }: positional index plus a geometric fingerprint
planned_anchors.what_is_missing: the fingerprint idea returns as SubshapeSignature; OM9 attaches it to a reference, not to every node

observed_symbols: pub fn regenerate_all(rc: &mut RebuildCtx): rebuilds the timeline nodes the scheduler marked
planned_anchors.what_is_missing: no persisted dependency edge: the node order is the timeline order, not a DAG the document can validate after reload

implemented_api: crates/om9-core/src/associative.rs: PortKind, FeaturePort, record_feature, typed_edges, validate_typed_ports
crates/om9-core/src/history.rs: Recipe.input_ports / Recipe.output_ports (serde default, skipped when empty)
reuse_decision: ADAPT the rebuild/dirty/persistent-id ideas; ADD the typed durable ports, the persisted semantic reference and the content baselines.
